title: Special Topics in Brazilian Literature; Tropical Dreams: Nature and Art in Brazil
description:
Cross-listed with LACS448Y, SPAN408O, and SPAN609A. Credit only granted for PORT409A, LACS448Y, SPAN408O, or SPAN609A.

Interdisciplinary examination of tropicality and nature tropes that have shaped current cultural, political, and environmental debates in Brazil. Taught in English.
